Class ContentDialog

java.lang.Object
net.tessel.fx.components.ContentDialog
public class ContentDialog extends Object
A modal dialog drawn over the window's own content (with a dimmed backdrop), for confirmations and short forms. 
ContentDialog dialog = new ContentDialog("Delete file?", "This can't be undone.");
dialog.setPrimaryButtonText("Delete");
dialog.setCloseButtonText("Cancel");
dialog.setPrimaryDestructive(true);
if (dialog.showAndWait(window) == ContentDialog.Result.PRIMARY) { ... }
Use show(Window) for the asynchronous variant that returns a CompletableFuture. Esc closes the dialog with ContentDialog.Result.NONE; Enter presses the default button.

    • showAndWait

      public ContentDialog.Result showAndWait(javafx.stage.Window owner)
      Shows the dialog and waits for the user's answer. The rest of the window stays responsive to repainting, but input goes to the dialog. Must be called on the JavaFX application thread.
